review_items.review_title: How is ragging at NIT Calicut?

aspect_evidence.evidence_summary: 'Stay away from so-called seniors, as simple as that. Don't entertain them. Don't share your contact numbers without knowing the people individually. They might rag you indirectly in the name of some club activity or something else. Stay connected with your batchmates.' Practical advice implying some risk exists, without describing severe incidents directly.

review_items.review_title: How is the hostel accommodation for 1st year M.Tech students at NIT Calicut?

aspect_evidence.evidence_summary: 'PG hostels are the worst in NIT C. You will get into Professor's Apartment in first year which is a flat having 3 rooms, 1 hall and a kitchen. Students are allotted to rooms as per the size of the room in the number of 4, 3 and 2; some people sleep in halls.'
